lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce4N4O4 (reduced formula CeNO) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/ncm (No. 143), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers coordinated by 8 neighbors (4 N, 4 O), while N and O each have 11 neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between N and O 11-vertex coordination polyhedra and corner, edge, and face sharing among Ce 8-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites.
